## DOMAIN ARCHITECTURE CONSTITUTION (DDD GUARDRAILS)

### 1. Architectural Boundary Rules (Paired Constraints)
- **Aggregate Root Encapsulation**: `FORBIDDEN: Mutating child entities or internal state from outside the Aggregate Root -> USE: Invoke explicit command methods on the Aggregate Root.`
- **Identity-Only References**: `FORBIDDEN: Holding direct object references across Aggregates or Bounded Contexts -> USE: Reference external Aggregates strictly by scalar identity (*_id).`
- **4-Tier Rule Separation**:
  - `Tier 1 (hard_invariant)` & `Tier 2 (compliance_gate)`: Enforced atomically inside the Aggregate Root; never bypass or delete without domain owner sign-off.
  - `Tier 3 (configurable_policy)`: Implemented as pluggable Policy/Specification classes; never hardcode inside entity methods.
  - `Tier 4 (ui_convention)`: Confined to presentation/UI components.
- **CQRS Read/Write Separation**: `FORBIDDEN: Polluting Write Aggregates with multi-table reporting joins -> USE: Implement dashboard/list queries as dedicated Read Model projections.`
- **Ubiquitous Language Enforcement**: `FORBIDDEN: Introducing ad-hoc synonyms or listed forbidden_terms in class/method/variable names -> USE: Exact canonical terms from the Bounded Context glossary.`

### 2. Bounded Context & DMML Routing Table
Before modifying code in any mapped directory, read its corresponding DMML specification:

| Bounded Context | Owner / Profile | Target Source Directory | Tactical DMML Specification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

### 3. Pre-Commit Verification Gate
Before completing any feature or bugfix touching a Bounded Context:
- [ ] Read the mapped `.ddd/04-models/<context>.yaml` and verify all `invariants`, `state_machine.transitions`, and `policies`.
- [ ] Confirm no cross-context internal entity imports were introduced.
- [ ] If domain rules changed, update `.ddd/01-raw-facts.md` -> re-run `compile_events.py` -> update `.ddd/04-models/*.yaml` -> pass `python scripts/dmml_linter.py --models-dir .ddd/04-models/ --events-file .ddd/02-events.yaml`.
